Unknown or incomplete argument: --help
usage: gue <game folder, .iso or Z-code story file> [options]
  --list                  show the games found and stop
  --game ID               run this game when there are several (rtz, znemesis, zgi, zork1-r88)
  --scale N               window scale (default 3, or 1 for a Z-machine game)
  --headless TICKS        run without a window for TICKS ticks of 1/60 s
  --screenshot FILE       headless: write the last frame to FILE
  --shots FOLDER          headless: write a frame every --shot-every ticks (default 60)
  --click T:X,Y;...       headless: click the left button at tick T
  --key T:KEY;...         headless: press KEY (F2, Escape, Return, or a character) at tick T
  --wav FILE              headless: record the game's audio to FILE
  --commands FILE         a Z-machine game: type the commands in FILE, one a line
  --transcript FILE       headless, a Z-machine game: no screen, its text to FILE (- for the console)
  --saves FOLDER          keep saves in FOLDER (default: the user's GUE save folder)
  --mt32-roms FOLDER      play the music on the MT-32 emulator with the ROMs in FOLDER
  --mt32-model NAME       cm32l or mt32 when FOLDER has both (default: CM-32L, as ScummVM)
  --trace                 log every kernel call
  -v, --verbose           debug logging
